description: US State Department travel advisory — Official U.S. Department of State travel advisory for any country: level 1-4 (Normal Precautions .. Do Not Travel), parsed risk list (terrorism, crime, kidnapping, unrest, health, wrongful detention, armed conflict...), indicator flags, regional Do-Not-Travel area warnings, summary, last update and link. country= takes a name (Mexico, Burma, South Korea, UK, Ivory Coast) or a 2-letter code. List mode instead of country: level=4 or level=3+ lists every country at that level; recent_days=N lists advisories updated in the last N days. Public-domain U.S. government data, cached 1h. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: travel_advisory
